entries.7dc1710ca064ad26: This business makes and sells resins and resin molded products such as nylon, ABS, PBT and PPS, polyolefin foam, films and film-processed products, raw materials for synthetic fibers and plastics, fine chemicals, electronic information materials, and printing and imaging materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥894,423 million, the second largest after the Textiles Business. Revenue decreased 5.3% from the previous year. The company explains that resins were affected by sluggish market conditions for automotive uses, chemicals by deteriorating market conditions, and battery separator film by weak sales. On the other hand, films for electronic components and in-vehicle capacitor uses, and new electronic information materials for power inductors, saw sales increase. The main companies whose business category is printed only as Functional Chemicals are Toray Fine Chemicals Co., Ltd., Toray Film Processing Co., Ltd., Toray Plastics (America), Inc. (United States), and Toray Battery Separator Film Korea Limited (South Korea), among others. Among affiliates and others, DuPont-Toray Specialty Materials K.K. and Dow-Toray Co., Ltd. are also listed under Functional Chemicals.
entries.81e541907b13e97b: This is the segment that management analysis refers to as the engineering business; in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the engineering subsidiary and construction subsidiary performed solidly.
entries.88340adf5cdf0d30: This is the segment that management analysis refers to as the water treatment business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, reverse osmosis membranes for the Middle East and plant construction projects in Japan performed firmly, while the business was affected by a slump in market conditions in China and intensified competition.

entries.b4259bee85eeb603: A materials manufacturer that makes and sells fibers, resins and films, carbon fiber composite materials, water treatment membranes, and pharmaceuticals and medical devices.
entries.b44125d2c1bbab21: This is a category that management's analysis groups as the “Resins and Chemicals Business,” and it describes the resins business and the chemicals business as its components. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the resins business saw growth stall under the effect of sluggish market conditions for automotive uses, and the chemicals business was also affected by deteriorating market conditions.
entries.cdc272737861fea0: This is a category that management's analysis calls the “Electronic Information Materials Business.” In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of new products for power inductors grew, while organic EL-related materials and circuit materials were affected by weak panel demand in China and intensified competition.
entries.d343598d1fc75dc6: This business makes and sells yarns of nylon, polyester, acrylic and others, cotton and spun yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, nonwovens, artificial leather, and apparel products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,051,102 million, the largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue increased 4.0% from the previous year. The company explains that apparel uses remained generally firm, although the sluggish European market and intensified competition from overseas products continued to have an effect, while industrial uses, including automotive uses, saw a sense of stagnation in market conditions. The main companies whose business category is printed only as Textiles are Alcantara S.p.A. (Italy), Toray Textiles Europe Ltd. (United Kingdom), Toray Textiles (Thailand) Public Company Limited (Thailand), Dongli Jiuyi Zhiran (Nantong) Co., Ltd. (China), and Toray Industries (H.K.) Ltd., among others.
entries.dd791d6a8b9f03f5: This business makes and sells carbon fiber, carbon fiber composite materials, and their molded products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥300,071 million, flat from the previous year. The company explains that aerospace uses recovered steadily, while general industrial uses such as pressure vessels entered a period of adjustment, and wind turbine blade uses were slow to recover. The main companies whose business category is printed only as Carbon Fiber Composite Materials are Toray Composite Materials America, Inc., Zoltek Companies, Inc., and Toray Advanced Composites USA Inc. (United States), and Toray Carbon Fibers Europe S.A. (France). Zoltek de Mexico, S.A. de C.V. (Mexico) is listed under the facilities status as an overseas subsidiary with carbon fiber production facilities.
entries.e2dc676cdc41af1b: Water treatment functional membranes and related equipment
entries.e3af6b0e68d49970: This business manufactures and sells water treatment functional membranes and equipment, general engineering, condominiums, industrial machinery, and housing, construction and civil engineering materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥266,898 million, and revenue rose 12.8% year on year. The company explains that in the water treatment business, reverse osmosis membranes for the Middle East and plant construction in Japan were solid, while the business was affected by a slump in market conditions in China and intensified competition, and that in the engineering business, the engineering subsidiary and construction subsidiary were solid. The main companies whose business segment is printed only as Environment & Engineering are Suidō Kikō Co., Ltd., Toray Kensetsu Co., Ltd., and Toray Engineering Co., Ltd., and among affiliates and others is TMT Machinery, Inc.
entries.f3146e1a20d191d6: This is the segment that management analysis refers to as the pharmaceuticals business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales grew mainly in China overseas, while the business was affected by the penetration of generic drugs in Japan.
entries.fcd18593e48f1370: This business manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥52,424 million, and revenue fell 1.4% year on year. The company explains that in the pharmaceuticals business, sales grew mainly in China overseas while the business was affected by the penetration of generic drugs in Japan, and that in the medical devices business, sales of products such as hemodialysis dialyzers and catheters stalled, although it worked to shift to high value-added products and reduce costs. The main company whose business segment is printed only as Life Science is Toray Medical Co., Ltd., and its transactions row prints “Purchase of medical devices.”
